justification.dataset: DANDI 000582 (Sargolini MEC tetrode recordings) is the canonical grid-cell dataset in exactly the right species, region, and open-field paradigm.
justification.handling: Real NWB streamed via remfile, two-LED head centroid averaged, NaN samples dropped, and units filtered to ≥100 spikes with correct spike-position alignment.
justification.analysis: Standard Moser-lab pipeline (occupancy-normalized rate maps, Pearson spatial autocorrelogram, Sargolini gridness) with an appropriate circular-shift shuffle null establishing the threshold.
justification.correctness: The 22/115 count, 0.46 threshold, ~60 cm median spacing, and ~1.0 bits/spike all reproduce from the committed CSV, are internally consistent with the figures, and are physically plausible.
justification.figures: Autocorrelograms show clear six-fold symmetry, population summary shows a real high-gridness cluster separating from the null, and examples are ranked by gridness, the actual effect measure.
justification.honesty: Claims are proportionate and the best cells are honestly labeled the clearest, but no explicit limitation is stated for an otherwise genuinely clean result, holding it at 3.
